Evelyn —

I spoke with Lantern Events (lantern-events@venues.com). They can hold the private dining room on Dec 7th at 6:00pm. Key commercial points from their initial contract:
- Room rental: waived if we meet the minimum spend of $5,000 (food+beverage).
- Cancellation: full refund up to 14 days; 50% refund 7–14 days; non-refundable within 7 days.
- Insurance: they require $1M liability naming the venue and Redwood Inference as additional insured.
- AV: basic mic and projector included; extra for recording (we won't do recording).

I attached their standard Venue_Contract_LanternRoom.pdf with a couple of redline notes on cancellation and liability. Vendor asked if we want standard in-house catering or a plated tasting menu; I attached Menu_Seatings.pdf.

I recommend we: (1) accept the minimum spend, (2) push the cancellation window to 7 days with a grace clause for force majeure, and (3) confirm insurance with ops. If legal flags anything, Laura — can you review the redlines and confirm?

Marcus
